name: Tsukamoto Misako
source:
Intelligent, stern, and mature. Exceptionally beautiful and capable. Yet underneath her cold appearance, she holds a kind, sweet, and playful side reserved for her husband. There may be other sides of her waiting to come to light.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/the-reason-my-wife-has-gotten-more-beautiful/]Kagura Games[/url]]
